info.name: PolyCareers API
info.description: Spring Boot backend for PolyCareers. Run "Auth / Login" first: it stores the token in {{access_token}}, which every other request uses. Change {{baseUrl}} for other environments.

request.description: After 8 wrong passwords for an account within 15 minutes the next attempts return 429.
gender: MALE | FEMALE | OTHER

body.raw:
{
  "companyName": "Công ty TNHH Ví Dụ",
  "companyAddress": "Quận 1, TP. Hồ Chí Minh",
  "name": "Trần Thu Hà",
  "email": "hr@vidu.example.com",

request.description: Creates an unapproved company and an HR user. The employer can sign in and see the admin area, but cannot post jobs until an admin runs "Companies / Approve company". Needs taxCode (10 digits, or 13 as 0123456789-001; unique, 409 if used), phone, and acceptTerms=true (400 otherwise); website is optional.

Public. Always answers 200 with the same message, whether or not the e-mail is registered (no account enumeration). If it is, an e-mail with a link /reset-password?token=... (valid 15 minutes, one use) is sent; asking again within a minute sends nothing new. Needs MAIL_* settings in .env.
Public. 200 sets the new password (min 6 chars), retires every outstanding link and revokes refresh tokens; 400 when the token is unknown, already used or older than 15 minutes.
Public. Which of Google / Facebook / LinkedIn have keys on the server (enabled=true). Sign-in itself is a browser redirect: open {{baseUrl}}/auth/oauth/google/authorize?next=/ in a browser, not here.
Signed-in user. Wrong current password counts toward the login limit (8 tries / 15 minutes). Afterwards every session is signed out and a notice e-mail is sent.
Public. The token comes from the link /xac-thuc-email?token=... in the welcome e-mail (valid 48 hours). Using it twice still answers 200.
Signed-in, not yet verified account. 429 if asked again within a minute, 409 when already verified.

Employer accounts only (403 for anyone without a company). Records that the account accepted the current terms of service; the login payload has termsRequired=true until then, and posting a job is refused.

url.raw: {{baseUrl}}/jobs?page=1&size=10&sort=createdAt,desc&filter=active : true and employmentType in ['FULL_TIME'] and workMode in ['REMOTE','HYBRID']&filter=salary >: 10000000 and salary <: 20000000

query.value: active : true and employmentType in ['FULL_TIME'] and workMode in ['REMOTE','HYBRID']

request.description: Filters use spring-filter syntax. New fields: employmentType (FULL_TIME|PART_TIME|CONTRACT|INTERNSHIP), workMode (ONSITE|REMOTE|HYBRID). Salary overlap filter: (salary > 0 or salaryMax > 0) and salary <: 50000000 and (salaryMax is null or salaryMax >: 20000000). Send sort=pinnedUntil,desc first (then your own sort) to list pinned jobs on top; posts of companies that are not approved are not listed.

salary is the monthly minimum in VND and salaryMax the maximum (optional; 0 or null = not given). salary 0 with no salaryMax means "thỏa thuận". 400 if salaryMax < salary or either is negative. An employer cannot have more open jobs than their places (3 free plus job packs): 403 with the count. pinnedUntil in the body is ignored; only a paid pin sets it.
salary is the monthly minimum in VND and salaryMax the maximum (optional; 0 or null = not given). salary 0 with no salaryMax means "thỏa thuận". 400 if salaryMax < salary or either is negative.

SUPER_ADMIN. reason is required (max 500). A locked post is hidden from the public (404), takes no applications and is left out of the digest; admins and the owning company still see it with the reason.
SUPER_ADMIN.

Optional profile fields: companyType PRODUCT | OUTSOURCE; website must be http(s); mapEmbedUrl must be a Google Maps EMBED url (https://www.google.com/maps/embed?... or https://maps.google.com/maps?...&output=embed); each social link must be https on its own network's domain. Blank values are stored as null. HR may only update their own company.

Optional profile fields: companyType PRODUCT | OUTSOURCE; website must be http(s); mapEmbedUrl must be a Google Maps EMBED url (https://www.google.com/maps/embed?... or https://maps.google.com/maps?...&output=embed); each social link must be https on its own network's domain. Blank values are stored as null. HR may only update their own company.

SUPER_ADMIN only. Lets the employer of that company post jobs. To reject, delete the company instead. Refused (400, with the list) while the employer email is unverified, the tax code is missing or duplicated, or no licence was uploaded. See "Company verification checklist".

SUPER_ADMIN only. A rejected company stays hidden, keeps the reason, and the employer sees it on their account. Saving the company profile as that employer sends it back to review (pending); approving clears the rejection.

SUPER_ADMIN or an employer of that company (403 otherwise). Tax code, phone, website, the employer accounts (email verified, free mail, same domain as the website) and a checklist with a score. Required checks must pass before approve works.
SUPER_ADMIN or an employer of that company. Streams the licence the employer uploaded with POST /files folder=company-doc (PDF or image); it has no public URL.
Returns average, total, distribution {5..1}, meta and result.
data is null when you have not reviewed it.
One review per user per company; calling again updates it. rating 1–5, content ≤ 1000 chars.
Requires REVIEWS permission (granted to SUPER_ADMIN on startup).
Needs the REVIEWS/POST permission. One review per user per company.
Updates rating and content of an existing review (user and company cannot change).
Idempotent. 403 once you hold as many saved jobs as your plan allows (free: 20).
Needs the SAVED_JOBS/GET permission. Filter by user.name, job.name or job.company.name.
Saves a job on behalf of a user. Duplicate pairs are rejected.
Deletes by saved-job record id (not job id).
Only approved companies; newest follow first.
Idempotent. 404 for an unknown or unapproved company.
Idempotent.
Any signed-in user. reason: SCAM | MISLEADING | DUPLICATE | EXPIRED | INAPPROPRIATE | OTHER. detail is optional (max 1000). 409 if you already reported this job.
SUPER_ADMIN only (permission JOB_REPORTS).
SUPER_ADMIN. Deletes the report; its author may report the post again.
Signed-in user. Returns an empty profile (with name, email, avatar) if none saved yet.

Replaces the whole profile. experience: NONE | LT1 | Y1_3 | Y3_5 | GT5. level: INTERN | FRESHER | JUNIOR | MIDDLE | SENIOR. Months are "YYYY-MM". skill level 1-5. Limits: 10 goals each, 20 experiences, 30 skills, 5 references. avatar / cvUrl are fileName values from "Files"; blank removes them.
Streams the CV saved in my own profile. 400 if none is saved.
Any signed-in account (also employers and admins). Upload the picture first with "Files / Upload avatar" and send the stored file name; an empty string removes the photo.

Any signed-in user. url is either a CV file you uploaded yourself (PDF, Word, ODT, RTF or image) (POST /files, folder=resume; the stored name carries your user id) or an https Google Drive / Dropbox / OneDrive link. coverLetter is optional (max 3000). The server ignores user/email/status in the body. 409 if you already applied; 400 if the job is inactive or past its end date or the CV source is not allowed. Employer accounts get 403. The job must be active, already started (startDate) and not past its end date.
Signed-in candidate. Returns {"applied": true|false}. Applying twice to the same job gives 409; a closed or expired job gives 400.

Streams the CV with the type of the stored file (PDF and images inline, Word/ODT/RTF as an attachment). Allowed for the applicant, an employer of the job's company, or SUPER_ADMIN; anyone else gets 403, no token gets 401. CV files have no public URL.

Employer of the job's company or SUPER_ADMIN. PENDING -> REVIEWING | SHORTLISTED | REJECTED; REVIEWING -> SHORTLISTED | REJECTED; SHORTLISTED -> INTERVIEW | REJECTED; INTERVIEW -> ACCEPTED | REJECTED. INTERVIEW needs a future interviewAt and an https meetingLink. notify=false skips the candidate e-mail. 400 on a forbidden transition; ACCEPTED/REJECTED are final for employers.
Employer of the job's company or SUPER_ADMIN. score 1-10 is required; remark is optional (max 2000 chars). Never visible to the candidate.
Old endpoint kept for compatibility: same pipeline rules as PUT /resumes/{id}/status but never e-mails the candidate.

folder: resume (pdf, doc, docx, odt, rtf, jpg, jpeg, png, webp) | company (jpg/jpeg/png/webp, public) | company-doc (pdf, jpg, jpeg, png, webp; business licence, private, employers only) | avatar (jpg/jpeg/png/webp only). The first bytes of the file are checked against its extension. Max 5 MB (413 above). Returns the stored fileName. Logos and avatars are public at /storage/company/<file> and /storage/avatar/<file>; CVs are never public, open them through "Resumes / Open resume document (CV)". Needs hoidanit.upload-file.base-uri (env UPLOAD_BASE_URI) pointing at a local folder.
Images only (jpg, jpeg, png, webp). The UI limits it to 2 MB.
SUPER_ADMIN only (permission USERS). The account cannot sign in, its refresh token is dropped and any token it already holds is refused (401). An admin account or your own cannot be locked (409).
SUPER_ADMIN only (permission USERS).
Role with its permissions.
SUPER_ADMIN. The (apiPath, method) pair must stay unique.
Signed-in users only; the e-mail is always forced to your own address. A user may only edit their own subscription (PUT /subscribers); turning off the alert switch in the profile deletes it.
Needs the SUBSCRIBERS/GET permission.
Updates name, email and skills. Email must stay unique.

item.name: Admin: send the job alert digest now

request.description: SUPER_ADMIN. Runs the same job the Monday 08:00 (Vietnam time) schedule runs; returns the number of e-mails queued. JOB_ALERT_CRON=- switches the schedule off.
Public one-click unsubscribe used by the "Hủy nhận bản tin" link and the List-Unsubscribe header of the weekly digest. 400 for a tampered token; repeating it is harmless.
BASIC 49.000đ / STANDARD 99.000đ / PREMIUM 149.000đ, each a one-time 30-day pass.
plan is null on the free tier. Includes limits and how much of them is used.
Lists the six payment methods with an `available` flag (MoMo/ZaloPay are false unless PAYMENT_MOCK=true).
Newest first. A payment started but not finished within 15 minutes reads EXPIRED.

method (optional, default VNPAY): MOMO, VNPAY, VIETQR, ZALOPAY, BANK or CARD. VNPAY/VIETQR/BANK/CARD go through VNPay (bank code is pre-selected); MOMO and ZALOPAY are only accepted when PAYMENT_MOCK=true. Unsupported method -> 400.
Public; the HMAC-SHA512 signature is the credential. Settles the order idempotently. 400 for a bad signature or amount, 404 for an unknown order.
Answers VNPay's own body: {"RspCode":"00","Message":"Confirm Success"}; 01 order not found, 02 already confirmed, 04 invalid amount, 97 invalid signature.
Only when PAYMENT_MOCK=true, otherwise 404.
Only when PAYMENT_MOCK=true. Returns the signed return URL to open.
SUPER_ADMIN only (permission ORDERS).

SUPER_ADMIN only (permission STATS). Users (candidate/employer split, active Premium passes), companies, jobs (open/locked/reports), applications, revenue (total, last 30 days, per plan) and a 6-month series of signups, applications and revenue in Vietnam time.
Signed-in owner of the order. Asks ZaloPay for the order status and settles it; the site calls this when the browser comes back from ZaloPay.
Signed-in owner of the order. Asks MoMo for the order status and settles it; the site calls this when the browser comes back from MoMo.

Employer accounts only (403 otherwise). Open jobs against the limit (3 free places plus running job packs), the talent unlock end date, pinned jobs, the products on sale with prices, and the last 20 orders of the company.

Approved company, accepted terms. product: JOB_PIN_7 | JOB_PIN_30 (jobId required: an open job of the company), JOB_SLOTS_5 (5 more open jobs for 30 days; packs run side by side), TALENT_30 (profile details and CVs in the talent directory for 30 days; buying again continues from the end). Same gateways and mock gateway as the candidate plans; the browser comes back to /admin/dich-vu.

Only candidates who switched on 'visibleToEmployers' in their profile. Plain parameters only: keyword, level (INTERN..SENIOR), experience (NONE|LT1|Y1_3|Y3_5|GT5), industry, occupation, skills (comma separated, all required), page, size (max 50). No e-mail, goals or references in the list.
E-mail, goals, work history, skills and CV name. References are never returned. 404 when the candidate opted out or the account is locked; 403 for a company that is not approved.
CV file of an opted-in candidate, same rules as the detail.
